decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast powerful colorless spells such as Karn Liberated, Wurmcoil Engine, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes ways to search for the UrzaTron lands (Expedition Map, Sylvan Scrying) and manage the opponent's graveyard (Relic of Progenitus) while maintaining flexibility with versatile spells like Warping Wail and Karn, the Great Creator.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells in order to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Grief while establishing a strong board presence with Seasoned Pyromancer and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion and synergies with cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Feign Death to maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Blood Moon and Blood Crypt adds disruption and flexibility to adapt to different matchups.

This deck focuses on controlling the game with powerful planeswalkers like Wrenn and Six and Teferi, Time Raveler, while utilizing Elemental creatures like Omnath and Risen Reef to generate value. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Leyline Binding to shut down opponent strategies. The land base is designed to provide access to a wide range of colors to cast spells like Prismatic Ending and Fury. The inclusion of Dress Down and Solitude adds flexibility to deal with various threats on the board.

This deck focuses on utilizing its cards to enable a powerful combo through the use of Underworld Breach. By filling the graveyard with cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration, the deck can loop spells and artifacts to generate significant advantage. Spells like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat provide interaction and removal, while creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer apply pressure. The deck aims to control the game with counter magic like Spell Pierce and Teferi, Time Raveler, while setting up its combo to overwhelm the opponent.

This aggressive Jund deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and controlling the board with removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt. It also utilizes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure the opponent. The deck aims to create advantageous board states with the help of Wrenn and Six, while also taking advantage of graveyard synergies with cards like Feign Death and Undying Malice. Additionally, it includes a diverse land base to support its multicolor spell lineup.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while utilizing spells like Lightning Bolt, Counterspell, and Unholy Heat to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes card draw and selection spells like Expressive Iteration and Mishra's Bauble to ensure consistency and keep the pressure on. With a mix of aggression and control elements, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

The main focus of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, and Tower) to generate a significant amount of mana quickly. This allows the player to cast powerful threats like Karn Liberated, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Warping Wail to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The companion, Jegantha, the Wellspring, provides an additional mana source and flexibility. Overall, the strategy revolves around ramping up mana production to play big threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize Cascade mechanics to quickly and efficiently cast spells, overwhelming the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck focuses on generating card advantage through Cascade spells like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute. By cascading into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly kill the opponent by infecting them with poison counters. By using creatures like Phyrexian Crusader and Blighted Agent, along with pump spells like Might of Old Krosa and Scale Up, the deck aims to deal 10 poison counters to win the game. The deck also includes protection spells like Vines of Vastwood and Snakeskin Veil to protect its key creatures. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently dealing infect damage and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Breach combo to cast a large number of spells from the graveyard, generating card advantage and overwhelming the opponent with powerful spells. It also includes cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Spell Pierce to control the board and protect the combo pieces. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana acceleration. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game through explosive plays and efficient use of resources.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with a mix of efficient removal spells, counter magic, and powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while slowly building up its own resources and board presence. The deck also includes powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines to close out the game quickly once the opponent is overwhelmed. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to all the colors required to cast its spells.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands - Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower, and Urza's Mine - to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This allows the deck to play powerful threats such as Karn Liberated, Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also utilizes control elements like Karn, the Great Creator and Oblivion Stone to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes utility lands like Sanctum of Ugin and Boseiju, Who Endures to provide additional advantages in certain situations.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively cast Cascade spells, utilizing card advantage and tempo to overwhelm the opponent. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to Cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to swarm the battlefield with creatures and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to protect its own game plan while keeping the opponent off balance. The deck focuses on high efficiency spells and a fast, aggressive strategy to secure victory.
